title: Crate openings show on a flat screen
text: Opening an expedition crate and other scenes away from the museum show on a big flat screen instead of the table. The table comes back when you return to the museum.

title: Save pictures can come out blank
text: A museum saved while in VR may show a plain dark picture on the level select card. The save itself is fine.

title: The monitor doesn't show the game's menus
text: While you're in VR, the game's menus are drawn in the headset only, so someone watching the monitor won't see them.

title: The first start can be slow
text: The first time you start the game after a while, it can take about a minute before anything happens, while the game and the mod load from disk. Starting it again later only takes a few seconds.
